text: Sorry for the wait. Partly built. Daily P/L has used Novig's wallet since v1.0.1xx (LedgerDays): per market, payouts minus fills and fees, on the game day, with open positions left out. All-time is the wallet now minus money put in (WalletProfit). Not built: the wallet figure disagreeing with itself (equity 109 vs cash+positions 182), and the all-time number still moving between views. That is TR3/TR4 in TASKS.md and I haven't fixed it yet. It needs a code change and a release, which I'm not shipping from this chat wake. The next engineer slot takes it first.
